paper_title: Search for New Physics in Electronic Recoil Data from XENONnT
notes: Paper reports multiple limits (solar axions g_ae/g_agamma, neutrino magnetic moment, ALP DM g_ae vs mass, dark photon DM). This extraction targets the ALP DM axion-electron coupling limit from Fig 6(c). Values are approximate reads from the log-scale plot; no numerical table is provided. Mass range (1,39) and (44,140) keV/c^2 with gap at 39-44 keV due to unconstrained 83mKr.
